title: Talia wakeup ops micro-checklist
content:
07:10 — wakeup notes (quick brain dump)
Quick context
- Night looked OK, a handful of ephemeral Pod restarts in us-west-2, rack7. No pager escalations.
- Alerts I care about this morning: GPU memory pressure, kernel driver OOMs, pod preempt spikes, and bg packet-drop alerts on rack7 top-of-rack.

Immediate triage checklist (what I run first)
1) Cluster health overview (5m)
   - kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep 'NotReady|SchedulingDisabled'
   - kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase!=Running | head -n 50
   - curl -s https://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query?query=node_gpu_memory_utilization | jq '.' | less   # quick mem% snapshot

2) GPU spot-checks (3 nodes that flapped last 6h)
   - ssh ops@rack7-node12 sudo docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' | grep runtime
   - ssh ops@rack7-node12 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits
   - if mem > 85% on 2+ GPUs: note for evict pattern, check pod logs

3) Network noise quick probes (rack7)
   - ping -c 20 10.40.7.1  # top-of-rack
   - sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -c 200 host 10.40.7.1 and not port 22 -w /tmp/r7-tdump.pcap (grab if packet-drop alerts present)
   - run netstat -s | egrep 'retransmits|drops' 

Top-of-shift actions (TODOs)
- [ ] Open JIRA-INFRA-3271: follow up on node kernel panic evidence (attach /var/crash logs). Assigned to Ravi.
- [ ] Run rolling drain on rack7-node12 -> cordon, drain, restart nvidia-driver.service, uncordon (window: 08:30-09:00 low traffic)
- [ ] Kick off capacity estimation for next week (quick calc below)
- [ ] Re-run the small-batch inference job (internal: perf-test/smoke/low-latency) on a dedicated shim pool to validate fallback latency

Quick calc — how many GPUs to reserve for predictable latency (rough)
- Current average concurrent inference sessions: ~520 (p50 session length 8s, p95 30s)
- Avg tokens per session: ~140 tokens -> avg token time ~0.025s per token on A10s (measured)
- Rough token throughput per GPU: 40k tokens/min -> ~666 tokens/sec -> ~4 sessions/s sustained
- To maintain 95th latency < 200ms with headroom, reserve ~140 GPUs for production (not precise, write up later).

Notes-to-self: commands and snippets
- Check logs quickly: kubectl logs -n redwood svc-infer-0 --since=2h | egrep 'OOM|cuda|segfault' | tail -n 80
- snapshot of pods sorted by restarts: kubectl get pods -A --sort-by='.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount' | tail -n 40
- drain steps (verify no long-running jobs): kubectl cordon {node}; kubectl drain {node} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60
- bring drivers up: sudo systemctl restart nvidia-docker nvidia-persistenced || sudo systemctl restart nvidia-driver.service

Handoff blurb for next shift (copy into slack #infra-gpu)
- Rack7 had intermittent packet-drop alerts -> I've collected tcpdump /tmp/r7-tdump.pcap if you need it.
- Planning a targeted drain+driver-restart on rack7-node12 at 08:30; ticket JIRA-INFRA-3271 created and assigned.
- Watching GPU memory pressure on the small-rt-pool; set an autoscaler target bump to +10% if p95 mem > 82% for 2 consecutive 10m windows.

Unresolved questions / followups
- Why did two pods on rack7-node12 show identical restart timestamps (04:02:17)? Race in eviction? investigate kubelet logs / docker events.
- Confirm whether recent kernel update rolled out to rack7 last night (check apt history or rpm -qa --last). If yes, correlate with crash timestamps.
- Confirm if the load-generator in perf-test was running overnight (it should not be). Check Jenkins job perf-smoke-nightly-2026-03-11.

Low-priority/backlog items (notes for later)
- Draft a small runbook for 'evict > restart GPU driver' flow (include sample scripts).
- Explore prefix-KV caching improvements for small-rt-pool workloads (Marta follow-up).
- Look into automatic cordon policies when node kernel panics are detected (tiny operator).

Personal reminders/brain dump (quick)
- Coffee. Meeting with Marta 10:00 to align on capacity calc.
- If I don't finish the drain before 09:15, postpone to 11:00 and update Slack.

End of notes. Will move important items into JIRA + paste a trimmed handoff to #infra-gpu before I leave.
